name: East Region
eyebrow: East Region · Changi, Tampines and the beaches
title: East Region:
tagline: Changi Airport, East Coast beaches, Pasir Ris and the heartland of Tampines and Bedok.
summary: The East Region is where most visitors first land: Changi Airport and Jewel Changi, with its Rain Vortex. It also has long beaches, East Coast Park and Pasir Ris, and the big HDB estates of Tampines and Bedok.
Changi has a long history, from the wartime Changi Chapel and Museum to Changi Village, whose hawker centre is a favourite for nasi lemak.

sport.intro: Tampines Rovers are the leading football name in the east, and East Coast Park draws cyclists, runners and sailors every weekend.

community.intro: Singaporeans from the east are often known for their love of the beach and airport, and many are involved in aviation and logistics abroad.

ancestry: Tracing your family in Singapore? The National Archives of Singapore and the National Library Board hold oral histories, newspapers, maps and records, and many are searchable online.
